# AnnotationGx

## Installation

You can install from github using:

``` r
remotes::install_github(
    "bhklab/AnnotationGx", 
    build_manual=TRUE, 
    build_vignettes=TRUE
)
```

## Example

First load the package:

``` r
library(AnnotationGx)
help(package="AnnotationGx")
```

Annotate cell line using cellosaurus:

``` r
name <- "A549"

mapCell2Accession(name)
```

Annotate drugs using PubChem:

``` r
drugs <- c(
  "Aspirin", "Erlotinib", "Acadesine", 
  "Camptothecin", "Vincaleukoblastine", "Cisplatin"
)

(compound_2_cids <- mapCompound2CID(drugs, first = TRUE))
mapCID2Properties(
    ids = compound_2_cids$cids,
    properties = c("Title", "MolecularFormula", "InChIKey", "MolecularWeight")
)

annotatePubchemCompound(
    cids = compound_2_cids$cids,, 
    heading = "CAS"
)
```

# Package index

## Dataset Metadata

### CCLE

- [`CCLE_sampleMetadata`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/CCLE_sampleMetadata.md)
  : CCLE_sampleMetadata is some preprocessed sample metadata from the
  CCLE dataset
- [`CCLE_treatmentMetadata`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/CCLE_treatmentMetadata.md)
  : CCLE_treatmentMetadata is some preprocessed treatment metadata from
  the CCLE dataset

### GDSC

- [`GDSC_sampleMetadata`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/GDSC_sampleMetadata.md)
  : gdsc_sampleMetadata is some preprocessed sample metadata from the
  GDSC dataset
- [`GDSC_treatmentMetadata`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/GDSC_treatmentMetadata.md)
  : GDSC_treatmentMetadata is some preprocessed treatment metadata from
  the GDSC dataset

### CTRP

- [`CTRP_sampleMetadata`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/CTRP_sampleMetadata.md)
  : CTRP_sampleMetadata is some preprocessed sample metadata from the
  CTRP dataset
- [`CTRP_treatmentMetadata`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/CTRP_treatmentMetadata.md)
  : CTRP_treatmentMetadata is some preprocessed treatment metadata from
  the CTRP dataset

### gCSI

- [`gCSI_sampleMetadata`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/gCSI_sampleMetadata.md)
  : gCSI_sampleMetadata is some preprocessed sample metadata from the
  gCSI dataset
- [`gCSI_treatmentMetadata`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/gCSI_treatmentMetadata.md)
  : gCSI_treatmentMetadata is some preprocessed treatment metadata from
  the gCSI dataset

## ID Cleaning

### ID Cleaning

- [`cleanCharacterStrings()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/cleanCharacterStrings.md)
  : Clean character strings by removing special characters and
  formatting.
- [`standardize_names()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/standardize_names.md)
  : Standardize Names

## Cellosaurus

### API query

- [`cellosaurusAPIVersion()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/cellosaurusAPIVersion.md)
  : Get the Cellosaurus API version
- [`cellosaurus_fields()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/cellosaurus_fields.md)
  : Get the list of fields in the Cellosaurus schema
- [`mapCell2Accession()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/mapCell2Accession.md)
  : Map Cell Line IDs to Accession Numbers
- [`annotateCellAccession()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/annotateCellAccession.md)
  : Annotate Cell Accession

## PubChem

### REST API query

- [`getPubchemCompound()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getPubchemCompound.md)
  : Retrieve PubChem compound information
- [`mapCompound2CID()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/mapCompound2CID.md)
  : Map compound names to PubChem CIDs
- [`mapCID2Properties()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/mapCID2Properties.md)
  : Map PubChem Compound IDs to Properties
- [`getPubchemProperties()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getPubchemProperties.md)
  : Retrieves the PubChem XML schema and extracts property information.
- [`getPubchemStatus()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getPubchemStatus.md)
  : Retrieves the status of a PubChem request

### VIEW API query

- [`getPubchemAnnotationHeadings()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getPubchemAnnotationHeadings.md)
  : Get annotation headings (name only) based on type and heading
  criteria.
- [`annotatePubchemCompound()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/annotatePubchemCompound.md)
  : Annotate PubChem Compound

## UniChem

### REST API query

- [`getUnichemSources()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getUnichemSources.md)
  : Get the list of sources in UniChem.
- [`queryUnichemCompound()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/queryUnichemCompound.md)
  : Query UniChem for a compound.

## ChEMBL

### REST API query

- [`queryChemblAPI()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/queryChemblAPI.md)
  : Query the ChEMBL API
- [`getChemblMechanism()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getChemblMechanism.md)
  : Get ChEMBL Mechanism
- [`getChemblResourceFields()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getChemblResourceFields.md)
  : Get the fields of a Chembl resource
- [`getChemblResources()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getChemblResources.md)
  : getChemblResources function
- [`getChemblFilterTypes()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getChemblFilterTypes.md)
  : Get the Chembl filter types

## OncoTree

### API query

- [`getOncotreeVersions()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getOncotreeVersions.md)
  : Get available Oncotree versions
- [`getOncotreeMainTypes()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getOncotreeMainTypes.md)
  : Get the main types from the Oncotree database.
- [`getOncotreeTumorTypes()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/getOncotreeTumorTypes.md)
  : Get the tumor types from the Oncotree database.

## HGNC Gene Symbols

### API query

- [`query_hgnc_by_genes()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/query_hgnc_by_genes.md)
  : Query HGNC BioMart by Gene Symbols

## Utility Functions

- [`strSplit()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/strSplit.md)
  : Split a character vector into a matrix based on a delimiter
- [`unlistNested()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/unlistNested.md)
  : Unlists a nested list and removes NA values and duplicates.
- [`matchNested()`](https://bhklab.github.io/AnnotationGx/reference/matchNested.md)
  : Match inside nested elements
